groups.name: ezkey.rate-limit
groups.description: Rate limiting for Auth API device-facing endpoints (pending, respond, verify, bind).

groups.name: ezkey.rate-limit.pending
groups.description: Rate limit for the pending auth-attempt polling endpoint.

groups.name: ezkey.rate-limit.respond
groups.description: Rate limit for the auth-attempt respond endpoint (per auth-attempt-id).

groups.name: ezkey.rate-limit.verify
groups.description: Rate limit for the enrollment verification endpoint.

groups.name: ezkey.rate-limit.bind
groups.description: Rate limit for the enrollment binding endpoint.

groups.name: ezkey.trusted-proxies
groups.description: Trusted proxy CIDR list for safe X-Forwarded-For resolution.

properties.name: ezkey.rate-limit.pending.key-strategy
properties.description: Rate-limit key strategy for the pending endpoint.

properties.name: ezkey.rate-limit.respond.key-strategy
properties.description: Rate-limit key strategy for the respond endpoint. Must be 'auth-attempt-id'.

properties.name: ezkey.rate-limit.verify.key-strategy
properties.description: Rate-limit key strategy for the verify endpoint.

properties.name: ezkey.rate-limit.bind.key-strategy
properties.description: Rate-limit key strategy for the bind endpoint.

properties.name: ezkey.trusted-proxies.cidrs
properties.description: CIDR ranges of trusted reverse proxies (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8).

values.description: Rate-limit per auth-attempt (correct for respond endpoint).
